# React Bits DSH reference package

Language: English.

Registers the `react-bits-license-review` reference Skill. It grants no tools and includes no upstream code, documentation, data, examples, or assets. See the project’s [.docs/en/guide/setup.md](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-react-bits-tonulls/.docs/en/guide/setup.md) for installation and use; read the [lifecycle guide](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-react-bits-tonulls/.docs/en/guide/lifecycle.md) for startup, verification, update/restart, disable/stop limits, and removal. See [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json) for source evidence.

## Automatic selection

Automatic selection is off by default for each Agent. Use `/dsh-react-bits-tonulls on` and `/dsh-react-bits-tonulls off`; direct Skill invocation remains available.
